findings: Six public recipe identities have different visible food contents and stable order/name labels. The three stations are visually distinct: enamel pot, fan/rack, and carton sealer.
Actual food appears at its committed station or own tray; empty trays identify AT COOK/COOL/PACK. Packed food is represented by a sealed box, and delivered orders have no remaining food object.

READY / OCCUPIED remains distinct from the delivery temperature band. Slow/fast cooler occupancy, simultaneous two-station work, cooked-ready and packing, and sealed-box readiness match the supplied actual snapshots.
Order sequence/next ID, attempt count, temperature and hold clock remain legible. Correct delivery records stay shown with their recorded temperatures; terminal action advice is removed.

The three actual mistake-loss frames truthfully show replacement raw attempts: wrong-temperature and wrong-order on TRY3, expiry on two TRY2 orders. No synthetic loss or invented closing scenario is claimed.
The longest packed action fits well before the fan label. The native icon clearly relates enamel cooking, cooling fan and packed carton, with 29 SVG/vector paths matching.
